sentences.text: Arnold Alois Schwarzenegger -LRB- -LSB- ˈʃwɔːrtsənˌɛɡər -RSB- -LSB- ˈaɐ̯nɔlt ˈalɔʏs ˈʃvaɐ̯tsn̩ˌɛɡɐ -RSB- ; born July 30 , 1947 -RRB- is an Austrian-American actor , producer , businessman , investor , author , philanthropist , activist , politician and former professional bodybuilder .	politician	politician	bodybuilder	bodybuilder

He served two terms as the 38th Governor of California from 2003 to 2011 .	38th	List of Governors of California	Governor of California	Governor of California	38th Governor of California	List of Governors of California
Schwarzenegger began weight training at the age of 15 .	weight training	weight training
He won the Mr. Universe title at age 20 and went on to win the Mr. Olympia contest seven times .	Mr. Olympia	Mr. Olympia
Schwarzenegger has remained a prominent presence in bodybuilding and has written many books and articles on the sport .
He is widely considered to be among the greatest bodybuilders of all time as well as bodybuilding 's biggest icon .
Schwarzenegger gained worldwide fame as a Hollywood action film icon .

His breakthrough film was the sword-and-sorcery epic Conan the Barbarian in 1982 , a box office hit that resulted in a sequel .	sword-and-sorcery	sword-and-sorcery	Conan the Barbarian	Conan the Barbarian (1982 film)	a sequel	Conan the Destroyer

In 1984 , Schwarzenegger appeared in James Cameron 's science-fiction thriller film The Terminator , a critical and commercial success .	James Cameron	James Cameron	The Terminator	The Terminator	Terminator	Terminator (character)

Schwarzenegger subsequently reprised the Terminator character in the franchise 's later installments : Terminator 2 : Judgment Day -LRB- 1991 -RRB- , Terminator 3 : Rise of the Machines -LRB- 2003 -RRB- , and Terminator Genisys -LRB- 2015 -RRB- . Schwarzenegger was nicknamed `` the Austrian Oak '' in his bodybuilding days , `` Arnie '' during his acting career , and `` The Governator '' -LRB- a portmanteau of `` Governor '' and `` The Terminator '' -RRB- during his political career . As a Republican , Schwarzenegger was first elected on October 7 , 2003 , in a special recall election to replace then-Governor Gray Davis .	Gray Davis	Gray Davis	Republican	Republican Party (United States)	a special recall election	California gubernatorial recall election
He was sworn in on November 17 , to serve the remainder of Davis ' term .

He was then re-elected on November 7 , 2006 , in the 2006 California gubernatorial election , to serve a full term as governor , defeating Democrat Phil Angelides , who was California State Treasurer at the time .	2006 California gubernatorial election	2006 California gubernatorial election	Democrat	Democratic Party (United States)	Phil Angelides	Phil Angelides	California State Treasurer	California State Treasurer
Schwarzenegger was sworn in for his second term on January 5 , 2007 .
In 2011 , he completed his second term as governor and returned to acting .
